title: 4 items...nothing with value apart from the salt pepper shakers?
text:
Got "geek fuel" box for my 14 teen year old.....NOT IMPRESSED...
only 4 items in box: throw pillow, toys r us t-shirt, book about Die Hard the movie, and ceramic Salt and Pepper shakers ( which my teen could have cared less )....definitely NOT anything valuable by any stretch and nothing for a gamer (tiny throw pillow, maybe?)
label: negative
